question: Group master courses by department. For each group, state the name of the department, the master course code, the number of subjects, the total new shelf price of associated TIP materials, and the number of unique TIP materials. Display the department and master course only if it differs from the previous entry. Include subtotals for each department and a grand total across all departments. All numerical values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code,
        sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name,
        tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS master_course,
        tso.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
        td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS tip_material_key,
        tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS new_shelf_price
    FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE
    LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),

    SELECT
        dept_code,
        dept_name,
        master_course,
        COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS num_subjects,
        COALESCE(SUM(new_shelf_price), 0) AS total_new_shelf_price,
        COUNT(DISTINCT tip_material_key) AS num_unique_tip_materials
    FROM base
    GROUP BY dept_code, dept_name, master_course
),
formatted AS (
    SELECT
        dept_code,
        dept_name,
        master_course,
        FORMAT(num_subjects, 0) AS num_subjects_fmt,
        FORMAT(total_new_shelf_price, 0) AS total_price_fmt,
        FORMAT(num_unique_tip_materials, 0) AS num_materials_fmt

),

        master_course,
        num_subjects_fmt,
        total_price_fmt,

s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS min_warehouse_load_date, s.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE GROUP BY subq1.unique_courses, subq2.total_courses, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.CATEGORY_CODE, subq2.min_warehouse_load_date FROM subq1 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON total_unique_students DESC LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.person_count, s1.min_mit_id, s1.unique_office_locations, NULL AS total_unique_students, NULL         tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code,
        sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name,
        tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS master_course,
        tso.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
        td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS tip_material_key,
        tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS new_shelf_price
    FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE
    LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),
course_agg AS (
    SELECT
        dept_code,
        dept_name,
        master_course,
        COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS num_subjects,
        COALESCE(SUM(new_shelf_price), 0) AS total_new_shelf_price,
        COUNT(DISTINCT tip_material_key) AS num_unique_tip_materials
    FROM base
    GROUP BY dept_code, dept_name, master_course
),
formatted AS (
    SELECT
        dept_code,
        dept_name,
        master_course,
        FORMAT(num_subjects, 0) AS num_subjects_fmt,
        FORMAT(total_new_shelf_price, 0) AS total_price_fmt,
        FORMAT(num_unique_tip_materials, 0) AS num_materials_fmt
    FROM course_agg
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT
        dept_code,
        dept_name,
        master_course,
        num_subjects_fmt,
        total_price_fmt,
        num_materials_fmt,
        LAG(dept_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_code, master_course) AS prev_dept,
        LAG(master_course) OVER (ORDER BY dept_code, master_course) AS prev_course
    FROM formatted
),
final_detail AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN dept_name = prev_dept THEN '' ELSE dept_name END AS dept_name_out,
        CASE WHEN master_course = prev_course THEN '' ELSE master_course END AS master_course_out,
        num_subjects_fmt,
        total_price_fmt,
        num_materials_fmt,
        dept_code,
        dept_name,
        master_course,
        'detail' AS row_type
    FROM with_lag
),
department_subtotals AS (
    SELECT
        dept_code,
        dept_name,
        '' AS master_course_out,
        FORMAT(SUM(num_subjects), 0) AS num_subjects_fmt,
        FORMAT(SUM(total_new_shelf_price), 0) AS total_price_fmt,
        FORMAT(SUM(num_unique_tip_materials), 0) AS num_materials_fmt,
        'subtotal' AS row_type
    FROM course_agg
    GROUP BY dept_code, dept_name
),
grand_total AS (

        'GRAND TOTAL' AS dept_name,
        '' AS master_course_out,
        FORMAT(SUM(num_subjects), 0) AS num_subjects_fmt,
